description: Attach human/agent recognition feedback to a prior resolve_fragment result. Use the resolution_id returned by resolve_fragment. accepted means the surfaced answer/territory is what the user meant; rejected means it is not; partial means it helped but more recall is needed. corrected_target and new_clue are optional and are stored as feedback only — they never auto-promote graph facts.
name: submit_resolution_feedback
title: Submit Resolution Feedback
